title: OutputResponse
description: A panel-bindable projection of a single pipeline node (HEL-904/HEL-906). Replaces the DataType/Metric response shapes. `config` shape varies by `kind` (chart legend/tooltip/seriesColors/axisLabels for `chart`; `format` for `metric`/`collection`, HEL-876) and is carried as a raw object.

panelCount.description: Number of panels currently bound to this Output (HEL-909 CR2). Populated on `GET /api/outputs` (list) responses only, to avoid an N+1 `GET /api/outputs/:id/panels` fetch per card in the Output picker; `null`/absent on the single-resource endpoints (`GET/PATCH /api/outputs/:id`), which don't compute it.

rootId.description: HEL-913: names WHICH pipeline root this Output is bound to when `nodeStepId` is absent -- a pipeline may have more than one root, so `nodeStepId: null` alone is ambiguous. `null`/absent when `nodeStepId` is present (the Output is step-bound, not root-bound).
